title: Death's Psychedelic Hunt
description: A skeletal Grim Reaper in a purple hooded robe holds a large pocket watch and a glowing green scythe while being pulled forward by three identical pink-haired archers and a green striped dog on red ropes. The background features a giant stylized eye with a green hypnotic iris containing a smaller eye, surrounded by black and white swirling patterns, Roman numerals, and floating green beetles.
prompt: Surreal psychedelic scene of a skeletal Grim Reaper in flowing purple robes holding a large ornate pocket watch and glowing green scythe, being dragged forward by three identical girls with pink hair in green outfits shooting glowing arrows, and a bright green dog with black stripes on red ropes. Massive stylized eye with green swirling hypnotic iris in the center, black and white optical illusion swirls, Roman clock numerals, and floating green beetles, vibrant trippy color palette.
